precepts.text: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly. Where is the land of uprightness? The land of Israel, and he dealt unjustly in it. They shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; the fire of thine enemies shall devour them. Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us, like we read in Ephesians 2. O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: the Babylonians, the Assyrians, and every ruler since. They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
precepts.point: In closing: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt. That is Esau. The way Esau treated us is going to be to his own detriment.

note.label: The Colossians & The CHRISTIANS of America

precepts.why:
“Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness”. If favour was shown to Esau, he still wouldn't change his wicked ways. It does not pay to be wicked.

“in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.” Where is the land of uprightness? The land of Israel. And what did he do there? He stole it. He will not behold the majesty of the Lord: he changes his image to a white man with stringy blonde hair and blue eyes.

“Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people”. The people are God's chosen people, the ones the heathen envy in 2 Esdras 2:28. “yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them. Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us”, like we read earlier in Ephesians 2: he is going to ordain peace for us and destruction for our enemies.

“O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us”: like the so-called white man, like the Babylonians, like the Assyrians. “but by thee only will we make mention of thy name. They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.” All of our enemies, all of these other lords that had rule over us, are dead. That is the hurt of the man that ruled over another.

precepts.text: Captain's precept: thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee, because he trusteth in thee. When we meditate day and night on the Lord, we build up our trust in him. That is what the second generation had to do in the wilderness that the first generation did not.
precepts.point: To be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace. Notice it is not just life, it is peace. You know why some of you still have so much drama in your lives? Because you are not applying this. You have no peace because you are trying to seek peace in things that are not God. The Bible talks about God's perfect peace, the peace of God which passeth all understanding: it will overcome anything you are dealing with. If it does not seem to work for you, you are still not applying what you need to apply.

note.label: Daily Bread for a Dying Man

precepts.why:
To be spiritually minded is life and peace, and Isaiah shows where that peace comes from: “Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.” This is part of the meditation, the daily feeding. If we are not feeding ourselves, we are being pulled away from God.

When we meditate day and night on the Lord, our mind is stayed on him and we build up our trust in him. That is what the second generation had to do in the wilderness that the first generation did not.

It is heavy, because it says to trust in him. People say, it doesn't work for me; that shows they do not trust in God. It is unbelievable how much goes back to your faith. If you are weak in spirit, your faith is weak too. If your faith is only strong when things are going your way, that is not faith at all; if it is only when things benefit you that you feel confident trusting God, then you do not trust in God.

The peace of God overcomes anything you are dealing with or struggling with. If it does not seem to work for you, you are still not applying it: keep your mind stayed on him and trust him, and he keeps you in perfect peace.

precepts.text: Building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost, keep yourselves in the love of God, not in the crosshairs of his wrath; nobody else can save you.
precepts.point: The spirits on those who could care less rub off on leadership too; do not play with what you know you are dealing with. The Lord set this hospital up for you; you do not throw the Tylenol in the trash.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
Isaiah says the Lord keeps him in perfect peace “because he trusteth in thee.” That is the key part. You trust in the Lord, you trust in his words, and you build yourself up. Jude says it: “But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost”.

It is the leaders' job to build the man, but once you have the foundation, it is on you to take the notes from the classes, apply them to yourself and add to them. Do a serious checkup from the neck up. Take an erasable dry marker to your mirror and write your issues with the scriptures next to them, what you need to fix, and at the top write: execute. Those are your orders for the day. If you don't see it, you're never going to fix it. Too many brothers and sisters don't write anything down: notes done, Bible closed the rest of the week, and then they're stressing, when the fix to what they were dealing with last week and what they will face this week came out in the class. We don't examine ourselves.

Don't ask the captain what he sees in you. What do you see in you? Leadership has the blessing of discernment, but that only goes so far; we can't see through you or know all the deep recesses of what you're dealing with. You have to go before the Lord, explain it, confess it, and ask him in sincerity to remove those things from you.

Don't play with what you know you are dealing with. The spirits on brothers and sisters who could care less can rub off even on leadership; a lot of brothers and sisters are spiritual vampires, and it takes a toll on leaders who love our people. God has this hospital set up for you to get the help, and the medicine is the laws. You have a headache, you don't throw the Tylenol in the trash, you take it. So why throw away the medicine when it concerns your soul and your salvation? Why be fearful of freedom?

“Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.” Keep yourselves in the love of God, not in the crosshairs of his anger, his rage, his wrath. It is our job to keep ourselves there. I can't save you, and you can't save me. It ain't going to be easy; you have to go through this fiery trial to get the kingdom. So do your part. You have the keys to freedom, and that is the trust that keeps the mind stayed on the Lord in perfect peace.

precepts.text: Meditate on the law day and night: that is the mindset that is stayed on him.
precepts.point: The spirits on those who could care less rub off on leadership too; do not play with what you know you are dealing with. The Lord set this hospital up for you; you do not throw the Tylenol in the trash.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.why:
What actually brings us peace? Not enlisting in this war, and not hoping America goes back to the old ways. “Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee”. The mind that is stayed on the Lord is the mindset of Joshua 1:8: the book of the law does not depart out of your mouth, and you meditate on it day and night.

That is your four chapters a day. That is you not separating yourself, and having that godly conversation consistently, as in Malachi, where they thought upon the Lord's name and a book of remembrance was written. That is making sure the sick among us in the congregations are well taken care of. That is you men doing the blitz, traveling, doing your due diligence by all manner to get out of that black shirt and get out here and teach your people, to become men of valor and soldiers of the Lord, and put in your brick.

You establish yourself on the laws of God. That is your meditation, your chief joy. You're not worried about what is played on the radio, and you could give a damn about what's on the internet unless it is funneled through the Bible so you can keep up with the times.

Then the news, the destruction and the chaos won't worry you. You'll have a Coke bottle smile from one ear to the next, because you know the mysteries. You're not fearful of freedom. The mind that meditates on the law day and night is the mind the Lord keeps in perfect peace.

precepts.text: I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee; sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee. Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate. Blood will pursue America, the Israelis, and the Europeans because they love shedding it and eating it. Mount Seir is still traveled today, so this dark sentence is about the future.
precepts.point: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see; but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people. White people envy us because God chose us and they want to be his chosen. Yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them: God's enemies, the Europeans and the Persians alike, and the fire is nuclear destruction.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
“Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly.” The land of uprightness is the land of Israel, and the abomination of desolation, the robbers of God's people, are in it dealing unjustly with everyone over there, killing and decapitating babies. “Yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them”: God's enemies are the Europeans and the Persians, and that fire is nuclear destruction. Ezekiel shows why their end is blood.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee.” God is going to prepare Edom, the white man, unto blood: he is preparing the place where his blood will be shed. The time is coming when blood will pursue America, the Israelis and the Europeans.

Why? “Sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” Because they don't hate blood. They love murdering and killing. You love blood, you like eating blood, you like shedding blood; you bloody man, so blood goes and pursues you. Even the name Amalek, in their own rabbinical tradition, is taken from am, a nation or people, and lak, to lick: a people who lick blood.

“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate.” The Lord is going to destroy them. That is a dark sentence, a parable. It is not talking about the past, because people still travel through that place today; it is talking about the future.

They will not learn righteousness no matter what favour is shown them, and what they are doing in that land will cause all the Arabs to unite against them, and the Persians will join after them. That is the blood that will pursue them.

precepts.text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, the sleeper cells, and thou shalt be for booties unto them? Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee, because of men's blood and the violence of the land. Venezuela, Cuba, Iran, Nigeria; seven countries bombed in one year. They negotiate while they bomb you, and the strike on the Ayatollah killed his children, nephews, and brother-in-law too. Now it is the Department of War, with AI programmed to kill and to surveil citizens.
precepts.point: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see; but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people. White people envy us because God chose us and they want to be his chosen. Yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them: God's enemies, the Europeans and the Persians alike, and the fire is nuclear destruction.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee.” The ones who rise up are the people being oppressed, the nations. “And awake that shall vex thee”: that is the sleeper cells. “And thou shalt be for booties unto them?” After Trump is finished with the Persians, they will go into secret vengeance, building all types of things in secret and waiting for the right time.

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee.” You spoiled Venezuela, you are spoiling Cuba right now, you are spoiling Iran. Trump has bombed at least seven countries in one year since he came into power, Nigeria among them, and it is just the beginning.

“Because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land.” Because you love blood, blood will follow you, as Ezekiel 35 said. Because you love war, because of the people you murder, because you are violent people. How are you trying to negotiate? They negotiate with you, and while you are negotiating they come and bomb you and kill you, and they don't care who is there. It wasn't just the Ayatollah killed: his children, nephews and brother-in-law were killed too.

Now it is the Department of War and the secretary of war; you are not about defense anymore. They are trying to program AI machines to kill humans, and to use that same AI to surveil the citizens. These things are the beginning of sorrows. America has spoiled many nations, and all the remnant of the people shall spoil it.

precepts.text: Before Abraham was, I am. Christ is the I AM of Exodus 3:14 who sent Moses to the children of Israel. John 14:8-9: show us the Father; have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? Isaiah 9:6 calls the child born the mighty God and the everlasting Father, and John 1:3, all things were made by him. Christ is not the Father, but the God who dealt with Israel in the Old Testament and created us was Christ, the only begotten; the Father made him and gave him the world to create, Proverbs 8.
precepts.point: Trust ye in the Lord for ever, for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength. Jehovah has three syllables and there is no J in Hebrew, so the name is Yah-ha-wah, three syllables, not Yahweh.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

precepts.why:
“Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength.” Jehovah has three syllables, and there is no J in Hebrew, so what was there originally is Yah-ha-wah, three syllables: not Jehovah, and not Yahweh, which is two. Then Christ gives us a heavy secret about who that Lord is.

“Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.” He is letting them know he is the I AM of Exodus: “And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.” That is Christ. He is saying, that Yah you were praying to, that was me back then.

Philip said, “Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.” And Christ answered, “Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip?” You want to see the Father that created you? I am the Father that created you. Isaiah calls the child that is born and the son that is given “The mighty God, The everlasting Father.” And John says, “All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.”

Now we know Christ is not the Father. But the God that was dealing with us in the Old Testament was Christ; that is why he said he comes in the volume of the book, and it is written of him. He is the only begotten of the Father: the Father only created Christ, and then said, this is your world, you create it. Proverbs 8 speaks of it, how he was daily the Father's delight, brought up with him.

So the Lord Jehovah of Isaiah 26, who “bringeth down them that dwell on high” and lays the lofty city low even to the dust, is Christ. They get mad online and say stop misleading the people, but that is the God in whom is everlasting strength, the one we are to trust for ever.

precepts.text: Therefore is judgment far from us; we wait for light but behold obscurity, we grope for the wall like the blind as if we had no eyes, saying some of them are good. We stumble at noon day as in the night, we are in desolate places as dead men, the walking dead; we roar all like bears, crying in the streets, and mourn sore like doves; we look for judgment, but there is none. Our transgressions are multiplied and our sins testify against us. Judgment is turned away backward, justice standeth afar off, truth is fallen in the street, and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: the hangings ruled suicides, the ICE killings, and the boy shot returning a wallet. We had sixty years to do astronomical things and chose twerking instead.
precepts.point: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them. Hosea 5:15: I will go and return to my place till they acknowledge their offence and seek my face; in their affliction they will seek me early. We only cry to the Lord when we are chastised.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

precepts.why:
“Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.” The only time we cry to the Lord is when we are chastised; as Hosea says, “in their affliction they will seek me early.” Isaiah 59 is that cry.

“Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.” Obscurity is confusion. “We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes.” Black people and Latin people act as if we have no eyes. We see the evil, and then we say, some of them are good, they ain't all like that.

“We stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men”: we are like the walking dead. “We roar all like bears”: that is us crying and screaming in the streets, “and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us. For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us.”

“And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter. Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.” The judgment we seek in this wicked kingdom is always turned backward, and the truth of God fails out here.

We are watching it on the screen. Young Black men found hanging from trees in Charlotte, Albany, Oakland, Albuquerque, Brookfield, Marietta, and on the campus of Delta State with the back of his head smashed in, every one ruled a suicide with no foul play. Keith Porter shot by an off-duty ICE agent on New Year's Eve; Dr. Linda Davis killed by a driver fleeing ICE. A sixteen-year-old boy in Houston shot on a porch while holding up a wallet he was trying to return, the shooter released, and the boy's family ordered to pay $20,000. No justice, no peace.

We had sixty years of a little liberty that Esau gave us, and we could have done astronomical things, but we dropped the ball. We wanted to sin and be like the other nations, twerking and dancing while the Bible warned us. Now the white man is undoing it, done pretending he is not the devil, and the hangings of the '40s and '50s are starting all over again. So be careful with your children. That is why we cry now: because of our sins.

precepts.text: A great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; nobody opens their mouth against Christ. 2 Corinthians 5:10, we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; John 5:22, the Father judgeth no man but hath committed all judgment unto the Son. The dead, small and great, were judged out of the books according to their works, whether in God's laws or against them, Ecclesiastes 12:14, every secret thing, whether good or evil. The sea, death, and hell gave up their dead; death and hell were cast into the lake of fire, the second death, and whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast in, the nations with them.
precepts.point: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain. Jeremiah 51:49: as Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth. Revelation 18:24: in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth. The judgment on this kingdom will be the worst of all.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.” Revelation 20 shows that day of judgment.

“And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.” That is Christ, in full power, and nobody opens their damn mouth against him. We thought it was the Father judging us, but it is Christ: “we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.” And “the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son.”

“And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened”: this is everybody, and the books are the Bible. “And another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.” As Ecclesiastes says, “God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.” We are judged according to our works, whether we were in God's laws or against God's laws.

“And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them.” That is what Isaiah 26 said: the earth shall no more cover her slain. Hell is the grave; those that died in the graves were given up, “and they were judged every man according to their works.”

“And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.” Death is finished at that point. And what goes with death and hell? The nations: “whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.” That includes all the nations. The Lord comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth, and this is where that punishment ends.

precepts.text: Michael shall stand up for the children of thy people, and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book. Israel is written in the book of life, not everybody. Jeremiah 46:28: fear thou not, O Jacob, for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee, but I will not make a full end of thee; I will correct thee in measure, yet not leave thee wholly unpunished. 2 Esdras 9:22: let the multitude perish which was born in vain, and let my grape be kept, for with great labour have I made it perfect.
precepts.point: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain. Jeremiah 51:49: as Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth. Revelation 18:24: in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth. The judgment on this kingdom will be the worst of all.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

precepts.why:
Revelation 20 says whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire. So who is written in the book of life? Is it the Chinese, the white man, or the Arabs? Daniel answers.

“And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time.” That is the indignation of Isaiah 26, when God's people must “enter thou into thy chambers” and hide “until the indignation be overpast.” There will be so much devastation that we will be fearful.

“And at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.” Who is written in the book of life? Israel, Daniel's people. Not everybody.

Jeremiah says the same, and they hate this one: “Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the Lord: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.” God is correcting us in measure, but he will not destroy us.

And Ezra: “Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.” All the nations were born in vain; the Israelites are the grape and the plant that is kept. So when the Lord comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth, Israel written in the book is delivered, and all the nations go into the lake of fire.

precepts.text: The mind has to stay on these things, and it will not stay there without continual meditation.
precepts.point: Make meditation a daily custom, a holy habit, as our forefathers did: somewhere alone and peaceful where the mind can be clear, because you cannot meditate in the middle of activity and noise. When you meditate continually on the commandments, the Lord establishes your heart, and the evil thoughts you battle begin to flush out of your mind.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
“Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.” The mind has to stay on these things, and it will not stay there without continual meditation.

That is why the Lord said day and night. A mind stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace, and the mind only stays there through the daily custom of meditating in the law, with the evil thoughts flushed out.

precepts.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness; that gate of the Most High into which the righteous shall enter is the straight gate.
precepts.point: The gates are opened that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in, and that nation is the remnant that keeps the commandments. Whose mind is stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace because he trusteth in Him.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

precepts.why:
“Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.” David asks for those same gates: “Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.”

The gate of the Most High into which the righteous shall enter is the straight gate. The righteous nation that keeps the truth is the remnant that keeps the commandments, and that is who enters the strong city whose walls and bulwarks are salvation.

precepts.text: Christ speaks of the strait gate and narrow way that leadeth unto life, which few find.
precepts.point: The gates are opened that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in, and that nation is the remnant that keeps the commandments. Whose mind is stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace because he trusteth in Him.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

precepts.why:
The gates opened for “the righteous nation which keepeth the truth” are the strait gate Christ speaks of: “Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.”

Few find it; that is why it is a remnant, the ones keeping the commandments, who enter the strong city in the land of Judah in that day.

precepts.text: It shall be our righteousness to keep the commandments; that straight gate is the law, turning neither to the left nor the right.
precepts.point: The gates are opened that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in, and that nation is the remnant that keeps the commandments. Whose mind is stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace because he trusteth in Him.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

precepts.why:
“And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.” It is our righteousness to keep the commandments, and that is what makes “the righteous nation which keepeth the truth” righteous.

That straight gate the righteous enter is the law, turning neither to the left nor the right. The nation that keeps it enters the strong city, and whose mind is stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace, because he trusteth in Him.

precepts.text: In that day Israel praises Him; the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my salvation, and great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee, the same God.
precepts.point: He bringeth down them that dwell on high, the lofty cities of the nations, and layeth them low even to the dust, so that the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy tread them down.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

precepts.why:
“Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength”. The Lord has many names, and Jehovah is one of them. Isaiah 12 is the same song: “Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.” Then: “Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.”

The Lord Jehovah and the Holy One of Israel are the same God. That is how one answers a Jehovah’s Witness: Jehovah is the Holy One of Israel. In that day Israel praises Him, His anger turned away, and He brings down them that dwell on high, the lofty cities of the nations, so that the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy tread them down.

precepts.why:
“for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.” Right now they have not learned it. “And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.” The whole world lies in wickedness, keeping none of the commandments, until the judgments come.

Right now the wicked are lofty and in high places, while Israel waits in the way of His judgments and seeks Him early with soul and spirit. When Christ returns there will be no more celebrating Christmas and the other pagan holidays; then the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

points: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name. The same God that made the heavens by his handywork; not the sun, the moon, and the stars that some worship, for we have a God that created all of that.

This Bible has been preached to you by your oppressor, so it is uncommon to your ears when we bring it out. Your presidents and the rulers of the nations are not God; the Bible says the earth is given into the hand of the wicked. The Lord gave a prime example with the Egyptians of how he destroys all whom God's people think are gods. When we put our trust in our oppressor, we make an agreement with hell and with death.

When we come into this faith, that is not the end goal; that is the beginning of our trial. God did not call you for no reason; he called you for his purpose. It is not a coincidence that you understand and hear this word.

note.label: Called to Magnify the Law: Lord Increase Our Faith

points: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee. Why is your mind at peace? Because you trust in the Lord.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: Sending your son into the military to fight against Christ for a white woman and a Hellcat is hating your child, and the new contracts do not even give what the military used to. The purple and gold, the laws and the prophets of God, is the ultimate military.

Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on thee: your four chapters a day, godly conversation, caring for the sick, the blitz and teaching your people. With the mysteries you will have a smile from ear to ear whatever the news says.

Because he trusteth in thee: build yourself up in your most holy faith. Write your issues on the mirror with the scriptures beside them and execute them; if you do not see it you will never fix it. Leadership cannot see through you, so you must go before the Lord and confess it.

The spirits on those who could care less rub off on leadership too; do not play with what you know you are dealing with. The Lord set this hospital up for you; you do not throw the Tylenol in the trash.

note.label: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

points: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord. The abomination of desolation is in the land of Israel dealing unjustly, decapitating babies, and what they do there will unite all Arabs against them. Like Balaam, they shall see him but not nigh; they will never be in the presence of the Lord.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

points: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see; but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people. White people envy us because God chose us and they want to be his chosen. Yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them: God's enemies, the Europeans and the Persians alike, and the fire is nuclear destruction.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

points: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah: we have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks. Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in. Not everybody: Revelation 21:12, the twelve gates bear the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel. Psalms 119:142, thy law is the truth; Revelation 22:14, blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may enter in through the gates into the city.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee, because he trusteth in thee. That verse is for those among us with mental disorders and psych meds, and for the mind in turmoil worried about a wife, a husband, a house, a car. Deuteronomy 28:28 prophesied the Lord would smite us with madness, blindness, and astonishment of heart, and many of us are undiagnosed; this offsets it.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Trust ye in the Lord for ever, for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength. Jehovah has three syllables and there is no J in Hebrew, so the name is Yah-ha-wah, three syllables, not Yahweh.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low, even to the dust. Christ is going to destroy kingdoms. Psalms 68:1-2: let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, let them that hate him flee before him; Proverbs 8:36, all they that hate me love death. As wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

Psalms 68:5-10: a father of the fatherless, God setteth the solitary in families and bringeth out those which are bound with chains, but the rebellious dwell in a dry land. Romans 2:7-9: to them who by patient continuance in well doing seek immortality, eternal life; to the contentious who obey unrighteousness, indignation, wrath, tribulation, and anguish, of the Jew first, Judah, and also of the Gentile, the northern kingdom. Thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor, because of what the wicked do, as with the school board in East Ramapo.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy. In the way of thy judgments have we waited for thee; with my soul have I desired thee in the night, and with my spirit within me will I seek thee early. Psalms 55:17: evening, and morning, and at noon will I pray; the poor of the flock must accustom themselves to praying three times a day. When thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness, the commandments.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness. Malachi 1:4 names the wicked: Edom said we will return and build the desolate places, the Renaissance, but the Lord will throw down, and they shall be called the border of wickedness, the people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever. In the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord. I do not care how religious they are or how much Torah and Tanakh they claim; look at Gaza and the schools up north.

Zephaniah 2:3-4: seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, seek righteousness and meekness, it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger. For Gaza shall be forsaken, Ashkelon a desolation, Ashdod driven out at the noon day, and Ekron rooted up, the same modern names on the map of the land of uprightness, with the time given.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, the prophets warning of destruction, they will not see; but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people. They mock our noses, lips, and hair, but it is envy, because we are the children of God. 2 Esdras 2:28: the heathen shall envy thee, but they shall be able to do nothing against thee, saith the Lord. Yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them, the group of verse 10.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us, for thou also hast wrought all our works in us. Isaiah 2:1-4: in the last days the mountain of the Lord's house is established above the hills and all nations flow unto it, starting with Israel; out of Zion goes forth the law, he shall judge among the nations and rebuke many people, nations still warring will be subdued, and then swords become plowshares and they learn war no more. That is the peace. Isaiah 66:19-21: Israel returns in increments; the Lord sends those that escape, the 144,000, to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan, and the isles afar off that have not heard his fame, to bring all your brethren out of all nations upon horses, chariots, litters, and mules to his holy mountain Jerusalem, and of them he takes priests and Levites.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us, Esau and Ishmael: Judah to America, the Levites to Saint-Domingue, Benjamin to the West Indies, Leopold's Congo, the slave markets of Mecca, Zanzibar, Tunisia, and Libya. But by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise; therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish. Job 20:7-10: he shall perish for ever like his own dung, fly away as a dream, be chased away as a vision of the night, a nightmare; the eye which saw him shall see him no more, and his children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods. Everything Esau and Ishmael took will be forced back.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou art glorified; thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth. Isaiah 60:21-22: thy people shall be all righteous and inherit the land for ever; a little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation, and the Lord will hasten it in his time. Daniel 7:27: the kingdom and dominion under the whole heaven, the whole planet, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, an everlasting kingdom that all dominions serve and obey. 2 Esdras 6:55: thou madest the world for our sakes. We will rule the planet.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them. Hosea 5:15: I will go and return to my place till they acknowledge their offence and seek my face; in their affliction they will seek me early. We only cry to the Lord when we are chastised.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Like as a woman with child that draweth near the time of her delivery is in pain and crieth out in her pangs, so have we been in thy sight, O Lord. 2 Esdras 16:38-39: in the ninth month, within two or three hours of her birth, great pains compass her womb and slack not a moment, and even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth; those hours may be two or three months or years depending on how fast the prophecies come. Isaiah 63:9: in all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: We have been with child: Galatians 4:4-5, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law, to redeem the twelve tribes under the law that we might receive the adoption of sons. We have been in pain, captivity; we have as it were brought forth wind, disobedience; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth, we did not change the world when we had power, neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen, because we joined them.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. John 2:19-21, destroy this temple and in three days I will raise it up, spoken of the temple of his body. Matthew 27:50-53: when Christ yielded up the ghost the veil was rent, the earth quaked, the rocks rent, the graves were opened, and many bodies of the saints which slept arose after his resurrection and went into the holy city; imagine the one you buried two years ago knocking at the door. 1 Thessalonians 4:16-17: the Lord descends with a shout, the dead in Christ rise first, then we which are alive are caught up together with them in the clouds. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust, in confusion and a low state, and the earth shall cast out the dead: that is deliverance.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee; hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast. Isaiah 60:8, who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows, the chariots; Revelation 11:12, come up hither, and they ascended up to heaven in a cloud, and their enemies beheld them. There will be so much devastation that we will be fearful.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity; the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain. Jeremiah 51:49: as Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth. Revelation 18:24: in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth. The judgment on this kingdom will be the worst of all.

note.label: War & the Pain of Repentance

points: This is a future prophecy: in that day this song shall be sung in the land of Judah, a joyous song of salvation, with a strong city whose walls and bulwarks are salvation appointed by the Most High.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: The gates are opened that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in, and that nation is the remnant that keeps the commandments. Whose mind is stayed on the Most High is kept in perfect peace because he trusteth in Him.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: Trust in the Most High for ever, for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength; the Lord has many names, which is how one answers a Jehovah's Witness, for Jehovah is the Holy One of Israel.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: He bringeth down them that dwell on high, the lofty cities of the nations, and layeth them low even to the dust, so that the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy tread them down.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: The way of the just is uprightness, and Israel waits patiently in the way of His judgments, desiring His name; with the soul and spirit they seek Him early.

When His judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness, for right now the wicked are lofty and in high places; when Christ returns there will be no more celebrating Christmas and the other pagan holidays.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: Even when favour is showed to the wicked, he will not learn righteousness and will not behold the majesty of the Most High; His hand is lifted up, but they will not see until they are ashamed and the fire of His enemies devours them.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: The Most High ordains, meaning establishes, peace for His people, for He has wrought all our works in us; this is the peace of verse 3, kept for those who enter through the straight gate of verse 2.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: Other lords, the nations, have had dominion over Israel even to this day, but by Him only will they make mention of His name. Those dead lords are deceased and shall not rise, for He visits and destroys them and makes their memory to perish.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: He has increased the nation and is glorified, removing it far unto all the ends of the earth.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: In trouble and affliction Israel has visited Him and poured out a prayer under His chastening, for in affliction the people seek the Most High early.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: Like a woman with child drawing near to delivery who cries out in her pains, so Israel has been in His sight, for the people are catching hell; they have been in pain and brought forth only wind, working no deliverance in the earth.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: The dead men shall live and rise; awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust, for the earth shall cast out the dead. This is the deliverance, tied to the chariots that gather the people.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate

points: The people are told to enter into their chambers and hide themselves for a little moment until the indignation is past, until the Most High destroys the nations, for He cometh out of His place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity, and the earth shall disclose her blood and no more cover her slain.

note.label: Isaiah 26: A Song of Salvation and the Straight Gate
